name: File Structure Analysis
description: Analyzes file naming patterns, resolution characteristics, aspect ratios, and bytes-per-pixel ratios to detect AI-generated images based on file-level characteristics.
mechanism: Examines file naming conventions (UUID, hash, AI-typical patterns), resolution matches against known AI model outputs, aspect ratio analysis, file size vs resolution ratio, and camera-typical naming patterns.
parameters:
AI resolutions: 512², 768², 1024², 2048²
AI naming patterns: UUID, hash, image_N, txt2img, comfyui
Camera patterns: DSC, IMG, P, DSCN
accuracy: Medium - 70-80%. Most effective combined with other metadata signals.
source: Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney output format analysis
